paragraphs.text: The Atogatog is a legendary Atog from Dominaria .

The Atogatog is a legendary Atog who resides on the continent of Otaria on Dominaria. It is known to be the apex of Atogs in that it rules over and consumes other Atogs for strength. It is a small green-scaled humanoid lizard with a mouth full of sharp teeth. It appears to wear a primitive crown and wields a stick atop a throne. Other atogs gather around it.
